rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that something is interesting or important enough to be reported as news.

example.english: This is such a big deal that it's newsworthy.
example.traditional: 呢單嘢咁大件事，梗係值得報道啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6 gang2 hai6 zik6 dak1 bou3 dou6 laa1

rows.note: Use this more formal expression when discussing whether an event or story has journalistic news value.

example.english: This event is newsworthy and deserves follow-up by major newspapers.
example.traditional: 呢宗事件有新聞價值，值得各大報章跟進。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 si6 gin6 jau5 san1 man4 gaa3 zik6 zik6 dak1 gok3 daai6 bou3 zoeng1 gan1 zeon3
